patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Lusha's shape. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Lusha leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Lusha share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences..
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Lusha-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene..

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over..

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Avoid Clay if you actually need Lusha's motion (B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, si)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
